description: This PHP source file defines the EndpointProxy class within the OrangeHRM reporting API. The class extends the Endpoint class and primarily overrides parent methods for request handling, parameter management, validation, and pagination/sorting configuration, serving as a proxy or extension point within the reporting API module.

classes.name: EndpointProxy
classes.description: A proxy class extending Endpoint, overriding methods for request management, parameter handling, validation, and pagination/sorting rules within the reporting API.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the Request object, delegating to parent implementation.

methods.name: getRequestParams
methods.description: Returns the RequestParams object, delegating to parent implementation.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Returns the ValidationDecorator, delegating to parent implementation.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Sets and returns sorting and pagination parameters based on FilterParams input, delegating to parent implementation.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Returns rules for sorting and pagination parameters, delegating to parent implementation.
